data.subtitle: Open code. MIT.
lead: Every DOM VIRUS game, the Fizlet engine and this site are open source under the MIT licence, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley. One icon outline carries its own ISC licence, listed below. Last updated 2026-10-29.

body.text: You may use the code for anything, including commercial projects. You may copy, change, merge, publish and share it.
Keep the copyright line and the licence text with every copy. The code comes without any warranty. The full text is in each repository's LICENSE file, and it is the version that counts.

items.title: DOM VIRUS
items.body: MIT, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley. The hub site, its artwork and the shared runtime the embedded games are built on.

items.title: Sherman Bytes
items.body: MIT, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley. The tank game and its Sherman sprites.

items.title: DOM Battlefield
items.body: MIT, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley. The squad tactics board game and the Battlefield site.

items.title: Battlefield Blitz
items.body: MIT, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley. The arcade tank board game.

items.title: Swarm Protocol
items.body: MIT, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley, except the bug icon outline (ISC, below).

items.title: Fizlet
items.body: MIT, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley. The small game engine and its site.

items.title: Lucide bug icon (ISC licence)
items.body: The Swarm Protocol bug outline is adapted from Lucide's bug icon and stays under the ISC licence. The hub's Swarm artwork uses the same outline. Copyright Cole Bemis 2013 to 2022 (Feather, MIT) and Lucide Contributors 2022.

items.title: DOM VIRUS runtime inside the games
items.body: Sherman Bytes, Byte Runner and Null Invaders each bundle the MIT-licensed DOM VIRUS runtime. Each game's own LICENSE covers it, and none has a third-party runtime dependency.

items.title: Site artwork notice
items.body: The hub's ship, runner, fly and tank artwork follows the games' own renderers. The notice includes the Lucide licence text.

items.title: React (optional)
items.body: The optional React adapter imports React from your own app. React is not included in any game.

items.title: Fonts
items.body: No fonts are bundled. The site and games use fonts already on your device.

items.title: Build and test tools
items.body: Development tools keep their own licences and are not shipped in the games.

items.title: Terms of use
items.body: How the site and games may be used.

items.title: Licence questions
items.body: Reach us through the contact page.
